text: Ethics in AI is becoming an important topic as artificial intelligence plays a larger role in our daily lives. One major concern is bias, because AI systems can learn unfair patterns from the data they are trained on. This can lead to unfair treatment of certain groups, so fairness must be carefully checked. Privacy is another key issue, since AI often collects and analyses personal information. People also need transparency, meaning they should understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means companies and governments must work together to create clear rules. This helps ensure that AI benefits everyone and does not cause harm.
